title: Jikkyou Powerful Pro Yakyuu '95: Kaimakuban
native_title: 実況パワフルプロ野球’９５ 【開幕版】
overview:
The Revolutionary of Pro Baseball Games

Pawapuro Sweeps the Saturn

Heated play-by-play commentary, an overflowing sense of presence, and breathtaking battles of wits between pitcher and batter. Packing outstanding real-game feel and the latest data, the all-out Opening Edition of Pawapuro arrives.

Step up to the plate with the big-headed players of Power Pro baseball. All twelve Nippon Professional Baseball teams are here with their 1995 rosters, along with Central League and Pacific League select teams. Play single games against the computer or a friend, run a full pennant race, take on Scenario challenges, or work on your skills in Camp mode.

- 1 or 2 players
- Approved by Nippon Professional Baseball and Tokyo Dome, with official pro baseball records
- Twelve Scenario mode challenges

プロ野球ゲームの革命児

パワプロがサターンを席捲

白熱の実況、溢れる臨場感、息をのむ投打の駆け引き。抜群の実戦感覚と最新データを搭載して、パワプロ渾身の開幕版登場。
